en-us.description:
GPROXY Desktop is the graphical Windows edition of an open-source AI API gateway. Connect your own AI providers behind one local endpoint and manage the gateway inside the application window.

Use the first-run setup wizard to choose a data location, configure the listener and create an administrator account. Manage provider credentials, model routing, load balancing, failover, access keys, quotas and usage from the built-in console. Supported routes provide OpenAI-, Claude- and Gemini-compatible API formats.

The gateway runs on your computer and sends requests to the providers you configure. Provider accounts, model access, charges and service terms are separate from this app. No model subscription or provider credentials are included.

This is the desktop application. For terminal-based operation with a browser console, choose GPROXY CLI. Microsoft Store manages updates for Store-installed copies. The desktop interface requires Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.

GPROXY is open source under AGPL-3.0-or-later. Documentation: https://gproxy.leenhawk.com/  Source: https://github.com/LeenHawk/gproxy

zh-tw.description:
GPROXY Desktop 是開源 AI API 閘道的 Windows 圖形桌面版。將你自己的 AI 供應商整合至統一的本機 API 位址，在應用程式視窗內完成設定與管理。

首次啟動時，透過設定精靈選擇資料目錄、設定監聽位址並建立管理員帳號。內建管理介面提供供應商憑證管理、模型路由、負載平衡、容錯移轉、存取金鑰、配額與用量管理。在支援的路由中，可使用 OpenAI、Claude 和 Gemini 相容 API 格式。

這是具有應用程式視窗的桌面版。如需在終端機執行、透過瀏覽器管理，請選擇 GPROXY CLI。商店安裝版本由 Microsoft Store 管理更新。桌面介面需要 Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime。

en-us.description:
GPROXY CLI is the command-line edition of an open-source AI API gateway. Run the gateway from Windows Terminal or PowerShell and manage it through its built-in browser console.

Start with: gproxy serve --data-dir "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\GPROXY-CLI" --port 8787
Then open http://127.0.0.1:8787/console/ in your browser. Save the administrator credentials printed on first startup. Configure a persistent GPROXY_MASTER_KEY before adding provider credentials if you want those credentials encrypted in storage.

Connect your own AI providers and manage credentials, model routing, load balancing, failover, access keys, quotas and usage. Supported routes provide OpenAI-, Claude- and Gemini-compatible API formats. The default listener is local to your computer; you control storage and network exposure.

This edition is operated from a terminal. For a graphical application with an integrated setup wizard and management window, choose GPROXY Desktop.

Provider accounts, model access, charges and service terms are separate from this app. Requests are sent to your configured providers. No model subscription or provider credentials are included. Microsoft Store manages updates for Store-installed copies.

GPROXY is open source under AGPL-3.0-or-later. Documentation: https://gproxy.leenhawk.com/  Source: https://github.com/LeenHawk/gproxy

启动命令：gproxy serve --data-dir "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\GPROXY-CLI" --port 8787
然后在浏览器中打开 http://127.0.0.1:8787/console/。请保存首次启动时输出的管理员凭据。如需加密存储供应商凭据，请在添加凭据前配置并妥善保存 GPROXY_MASTER_KEY。

本版本通过终端操作。如需集成设置向导和管理窗口的图形应用，请选择 GPROXY Desktop。

供应商账号、模型访问权限、费用和服务条款独立于本应用，请求会发送到你配置的供应商。本应用不附带模型订阅或供应商凭据。商店安装版本由 Microsoft Store 管理更新。

本版本透過終端機操作。如需整合設定精靈與管理視窗的圖形應用程式，請選擇 GPROXY Desktop。
